name: Don't be fooled
source:
The protagonist departs on a journey to defeat the demon king, with a hero in tow.

Said hero, however, is self-centered and overbearing.

She gradually starts getting fed up with him...

[translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/18046]Freem![/url]]
translation:
主人公踏上旅程，身边带着一位勇者，目标是打败魔王。

然而，这位勇者以自我为中心又盛气凌人。

她逐渐开始受够了他……

（译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/18046]Freem![/url]）
